description: MCC Solutions' own calculators (mortgage payment, amortization, cap rate, DSCR, break-even, margins, ratios, timecard hours, unit conversions and about 100 more), run with the same formulas as the pages. Call with no arguments, or a word or two in calculator, to list them; with a calculator id to see its inputs; with inputs to get the answer and the page it comes from. General math, not tax, legal or financial advice.

calculator.description: A calculator id from the list (e.g. mortgage), or words to search for (e.g. loan)

inputs.description: The calculator's inputs by name, e.g. {"loan": 300000, "rate": 6.5, "years": 30}

name: run_calculator
title: Run one of MCC's calculators
